failure.title: Concurrent mutation runners stalled the static tail and inflated timeout outcomes
failure.diagnosis: Stryker concurrency two began with one checker and one test runner, then converted the released checker token into a second runner. The concurrent Vitest/PGlite processes contended during database setup and full-suite static mutants, causing hook-timeout-only apparent kills, wall-clock timeouts, and an observable sixteen-minute counter stall.
failure.note: The rejected full run stopped after 1,994 of 2,207 mutants with 26 provisional timeouts after its counter had remained at 1,985 for sixteen minutes. The exact 18-mutant publication tail then produced 13 kills and five timeouts with dual runners, while the serialized control killed 18 of 18 with zero timeouts. Neither incomplete or contention-affected result was accepted as release evidence.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
